model_name: Risk-Aware Abstention Mammographic Mass Decision Agent
architecture_overview: Composite ensemble: 300-tree Scikit-Learn RandomForestClassifier primary predictor; 30-member bootstrap ensemble for predictive disagreement (U); 200-tree IsolationForest for novelty scoring (A); asymmetric consequence weighting (C); validation percentile routing policy.
intended_use: Secondary triage prioritization and educational demonstration. Assisting clinical workflows by routing high-confidence cases to Automatic processing while escalating borderline cases.
out_of_scope_uses: Standalone autonomous medical diagnosis, emergency patient discharge, direct patient self-diagnosis without qualified radiologist review.
relevant_factors: Patient age, mass shape, mass margin, radiological breast tissue density. NOT trained on symptoms, family history, breast implants, or non-mass lesions.
ethical_considerations: High error rate in Automatic tier (20%) reflects dataset limitations and confirms this prototype must never be used for actual patient care. Explanations are strictly grounded and rule-checked.
caveats_and_recommendations: The model demonstrates the abstention *architecture*, not clinical efficacy. Any clinical application requires prospective multi-center trial validation on modern full-field digital mammography (FFDM) or tomosynthesis (DBT) data.
